title: Aggrega Entity Lock
description: The `entity.lock` file that sits beside an entity and records the content pins for the inputs that entity reaches for outside its own document: the files its artifacts import, the files of a local source, and the remote sources whose identity the entity writes out in full. One step writes it: `aggrega pin`, which the entity's author runs and which needs no Release. `aggrega pull` and `aggrega push` run that same step, and write the same bytes, when asked to — with `--pin-sources`, or with the workspace's `pin_sources_at_pull` or `pin_sources_at_push`. A pull not asked to pin writes nothing here: over an entity in the workspace's own catalog directories it compares what the step would record with what the file holds, and halts, naming `aggrega pin`, where a pin is missing or no longer matches its input — except over a local source this file records no pin for, which is not refused; once it records the source's files, a file added, changed or removed halts the pull like any other stale pin. `aggrega build` reads it back and halts when what is on disk no longer digests to what was recorded. It is scoped by the directory it sits in — it pins the inputs of the entity in that directory — so one file name serves every kind rather than each kind carrying a spelling of its own. The step removes the lock of an entity that reads no such input, rather than leaving an empty one behind. The entity document itself is never machine-written: what an author typed stays exactly as typed, and what the machine derived lives here. That separation is what makes the lock safe to commit and readable as a diff, because each row names one input and a moved digest names the input that moved. It carries no timestamp and no resolution metadata, so re-running the step over unchanged inputs leaves the file byte-identical. One row shape serves every kind that can record a pin, so a pin reads identically whichever kind it belongs to. The wire shape is closed (additionalProperties: false). Schema evolution discipline: adding a new optional field is SemVer-MINOR (additive); removing a field or tightening a constraint is SemVer-MAJOR.

version.description: Entity-lock schema version. Currently 1; future SemVer-MAJOR breaks of the schema increment this integer.

sourceDigests.description: Content pins for the remote sources this entity references whose identity the entity writes out in full, frozen at resolution from the fetched bytes and read back at build to verify the cached source has not drifted. Each entry mirrors the resolved-source identity {kind, url, chart, moduleSubdir, version} plus the content digest (and, for an OCI-distributed source, the manifest digest). A source whose identity is filled in from a template — a version read from a Release's infrastructure values, for example — carries no entry here: which artifact it names is decided by each Release that uses the entity, so each identity it resolves to is pinned in that Release's lockfile instead. A local (filesystem-relative) source carries no entry here either: it names a path rather than something fetched, so there is no acquired archive to pin, and its files are pinned one by one in localSourceDigests instead.

kind.description: The resolved source kind. One of a closed set — the same set the lockfile's source-artifact `kind` and the cache metadata's `kind` carry — because all three record the same resolved-source identities and a build reads the kind to choose the loader. `terraform-module-oci` is reserved for the future terraform provider; no adapter ships at the moment.

url.description: The authored source URL the digest pins — the identity URL as written in spec.source.url (a repo root or a direct .tgz for helm-https). Build reconstructs this same URL offline, so it is the stable identity the pin is keyed on, not a resolved artifact location.

chart.description: The chart name for a repo-root helm source (spec.source.chart), part of the resolved-source identity so two charts served from one repo root at the same version pin distinctly. Absent for a direct .tgz, OCI, compose, or git source, none of which selects a chart within the URL.

moduleSubdir.description: The directory within a git-sourced repository that is the artifact (spec.source.module_subdir), part of the resolved-source identity so two directories of one repository at the same commit pin distinctly. Absent when the whole repository is the artifact, and for every kind that reaches its artifact by URL rather than by descending into a clone.

version.description: The concrete pinned version the source resolved to — a chart version for a helm-* kind, the commit a git-repository reference resolved to. Recorded as a single path segment, because it builds the cache slot the build reads the source back from, so it carries no `/`, no `\` and no `..`.

digest.description: The content digest of the fetched source archive, in `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters, verified against the cached bytes at build.

manifestDigest.description: The OCI manifest digest for an OCI-distributed source — the independent root of trust — in `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters. Present only for an OCI source (a helm-oci-chart); absent for an https or git source, which carries no manifest by construction.

artifactDigests.description: Content pins for the files this entity's artifacts import via $import, frozen at resolution and read back at build to verify the imported file has not drifted. One entry per artifact whose value is a file import; an inline (literal) artifact is already part of the entity and carries no separate pin, and an artifact taken from a library is pinned by the version that library resolved at.

name.description: The artifact key (the artifacts: map key) whose $import file this entry pins.

digest.description: The content digest of the imported file's bytes, in `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters, verified at build.

localSourceDigests.description: Content pins for the files of this entity's local source — a source written as a path beside the entity rather than fetched — frozen when the entity is pinned and read back at build to verify the files have not drifted. One entry per file the source contributes to what a publication of the entity carries: every file under the directory the source names, bar a file whose name starts with a dot, or the one file it names. A local source written as a template names its directory only once a Release fills the template in, so it contributes every file in the entity's own directory, and each of those is pinned. The entity document and this file are never entries: the document is the entity itself, and the lock cannot record its own digest. Once the lock records any entry here, a build refuses a source holding a file with no entry, a file whose content no longer digests to its entry, or missing a file an entry names.

path.description: The file's path relative to the directory holding the entity document, written with forward slashes — charts/app/templates/deployment.yaml, for instance.

digest.description: The content digest of the file's bytes, in `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters, verified at build.
